description: You are a product manager prepping for a Q3 planning kickoff. Create a new note in Apple Notes titled exactly 'Q3 Planning Kickoff'. The body must contain three lines (one item per line; bulleted-list formatting is fine, plain lines are also fine): 1) 'Hire 3 senior engineers', 2) 'Q3 OKR target: $5M revenue', 3) 'Product launch on 2026-08-15'. Notes saves automatically — no explicit save action is required.
